title: mcp_audit
description: <case>/mcp_audit.json — what an MCP server (`papertrace mcp`) knows about the last audit it started in this case folder. The audit job writes it with state `running` before the pipeline touches anything, and rewrites it when the job ends. A server stopped mid-audit therefore leaves `running` behind, and a later server reads that as an audit that never finished: it refuses to serve the folder as a result rather than present half-written files as one. Absent means no MCP server has audited this case; the CLI never writes it.

state.description: `running` while the job runs — and forever, when the server stopped before the job ended, which a later server reports as `interrupted`. `failed`: the pipeline stopped, and what is on disk may mix that run with an earlier one.

manuscript.description: The audited PDF's file name, as refs_manifest.json keeps it.

started.description: When the job started: UTC, ISO 8601, to the second.

ended.description: When the job ended; null while it runs, and on an audit whose server stopped first.

error.description: Why the audit failed — the last lines the pipeline printed, or the exception's type and message. Empty unless `state` is `failed`.

scout.description: Whether this audit scanned the literature. false: any out/scout.json in the folder belongs to an earlier run, and is not served as this audit's.
